description.cryosat.atmospheric_compress: Compresses the surrounding atmosphere into a gas. Needs open air around it, and output thins out at high altitude.
description.cryosat.cargo_receiver: Catches cargo sent down by missions in orbit and holds it for pipes. Link missions to it with an Uplink Card. Cargo that does not fit waits in orbit until there is room.
description.cryosat.cryo_casing: Insulated casing for the Cryogenic Liquefaction Plant, a hollow box from 3x3x3 up to 9x9x9.
description.cryosat.cryo_valve: Chemical port of the Liquefaction Plant, and a power input. Sneak right click to switch between input and the three outputs; output modes push into anything attached.
description.cryosat.cryocooler: Pumps heat out of the Liquefaction Plant. Power the plant through any Cryocooler or Cryo Valve; all coolers share one energy buffer. The colder the plant, the more energy each unit of cooling costs.
description.cryosat.field_coil: Superconducting magnet winding for a ring around a Mekanism fusion reactor. Build a closed square loop of them level with the reactor's middle layer, one or two blocks out from it, with a Field Coil Controller in the loop.
description.cryosat.field_coil_controlle: Runs a ring of Field Coils around a fusion reactor. While kept cold with liquid nitrogen, each complete loop adds 25 percent of the reactor's energy output. Up to three loops: the reactor's middle layer and the layers above and below it.
description.cryosat.heat_rejection_port: Dumps the heat removed by Cryocoolers, plus the energy they spent, into adjacent heat handlers such as Thermodynamic Conductors or a Thermoelectric Boiler.
description.cryosat.launch_controller: Brain of the Launch Pad and home of the Rocket Assembly. Exactly one per pad, on the outer ring. A redstone pulse launches a ready rocket.
description.cryosat.launch_pad_fuel_port: Fuels the Launch Pad from Mekanism tubes and item pipes: oxidiser, propellant and solid propellant grains. Goes on the outer ring of the pad.
description.cryosat.launch_pad_plating: Deck of the Launch Pad, a flat 5x5 platform. Keep the 3x3 column above its centre clear for the rocket.
description.cryosat.liquefaction_control: Brain of the Cryogenic Liquefaction Plant. Exactly one per plant.
description.cryosat.mission_control: Lists your missions in orbit. Rename them, link them to a Cargo Receiver with an Uplink Card, or decommission them. Each player sees their own missions.
description.cryosat.superconducting_sepa: Sorts cargo from orbit as it reaches a Cargo Receiver next to it: every batch comes out 50 percent bigger, with a chance of rare extras. Needs liquid nitrogen to stay cold and gives most of it back as nitrogen gas.
